About.headline: I didn't study graphic design. I studied film.
About.p1: Film taught me something most designers don't know: every image communicates something, whether you intend it or not. Emptiness communicates. Omission is a decision.
About.p2: Over time I understood that brands have the same problem. And solving it doesn't end with a logo — it ends with the systems that make that logo work in the real world.
About.p3: is the method. The software is the consequence.

FAQ.title: Questions Before Starting
FAQ.q1: Why do you talk about 'Visual Sovereignty' and not just logos?
FAQ.a1: Because a logo on its own isn't enough. I design the whole system (symbol, colors, typography and usage rules) so your brand is recognized without having to compete on price.
FAQ.q2: How much do you need from me during the process?
FAQ.a2: Quite a lot at the start. The first step, Discovery, requires deep collaboration: my LogoCodeX™ method doesn't work with generic forms, I need to understand your vision to turn it into a visual identity. After that the technical work is on me, and you come back in for the Joint review.
FAQ.q3: Do you work with any type of company or industry?
FAQ.a3: Yes. The LogoCodeX™ method doesn't depend on the industry — it depends on having something real to tell. I've worked with software, consulting, real estate, engineering and fitness. What I do require is commitment to the process: if you're looking for quick design without depth, my way of working will feel excessive for that.
FAQ.a4: I don't deliver loose files. I deliver a system that is ready to use: vector versions of the logo, exact color codes, typefaces and a Brand Manual that explains how and why each piece is used. Depending on the package, social media applications, iconography and motion graphics are added.
FAQ.q5: How do you integrate Artificial Intelligence into the process?
FAQ.a5: Through my 'Expanded Creativity' pillar. I use advanced AI models to accelerate diagnostics, generate complex iterations, and test applications in record time. However, art direction, semiotic strategy, and final vector refinement remain strictly under human control to guarantee absolute originality.

origin.title: The Origin of the Method
origin.p1Pre: LogoCodeX™ was born as a response to a crisis: the abundance of aesthetically correct but
origin.p2: The proliferation of generic templates has led many brands to differentiate only by color or typography, lacking a symbolic core capable of sustaining a long-term narrative.
origin.quote: The premise is radical: Your design must not only be attractive — it must activate a chain of cultural, emotional and narrative associations in collective memory.
origin.traditionalDesc: A static graphic element that identifies.
origin.li3Rest: It's a character in the brand's story.

pillars.title: The 3 Theoretical Pillars
pillars.p1Desc: I understand how signs work. I use the triadic model (Icon, Index, Symbol) and Barthes' levels (Denotation, Connotation, Myth) to ensure the message is read with the correct intention.
pillars.p2Desc: I connect with universal patterns of the collective unconscious. I define whether your brand is a "Hero", a "Creator" or a "Sage" to generate immediate and emotional identification.
pillars.p3Desc: I transform a graphic sign into a story. I ensure coherence between the symbol, the brand promise and its cultural context.
